entities.summary: Johan Christian Viggo Ullmann was a Norwegian educator and politician with Venstre, the Norwegian Liberal party. He was the son of the author Vilhelmine Ullmann, brother of the feminist Ragna Nielsen and the great-grandfather of actress Liv Ullmann. Norway's first social doctor was his grandchild, also named Viggo Ullmann. Viggo translated Progress and Poverty to Norwegian in 1886.
